# T1917-055 — Rhinoceros skull coordinate transformations (Thompson 1917)

**Claim:** The skulls of rhinoceroses and their allies (Hyrachyus, Aceratherium, Titanotherium, tapir, horse, rabbit comparisons after Osborn) differ by coordinate transformation of a common skull diagram.

**Source:** Thompson, D.W. (1917) *On Growth and Form*, Ch. XVII, pp. 760–764, Figs. 394–400; skull drawings after Osborn (1898).

**Validation script:** `thompson/claims/t1917-055_on-the-theory-of-transformations.py`

**Verdict:** `result.json` (generated by the script).
